from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class LiabilityRecord(BaseModel):
    """Extracted liability data from a single company/trust financial document."""
    entity_name: str | None = Field(description="Name of the company or trust (e.g., 'Ascent Industries Co.')")
    liability_amount: float | None = Field(description="The numeric value of Total Liabilities as reported in the document")
    unit_scale: str | None = Field(description="The scale of the reported amount (e.g., 'thousands', 'millions', 'dollars')")
    reporting_period: str | None = Field(description="The end date of the reporting period (e.g., 'March 31, 2024')")
    liability_line_label: str | None = Field(description="The specific line item label used in the document for this total (e.g., 'Total Liabilities')")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    liability_records: list[LiabilityRecord]
